build: Copy the driver to crates/promql/examples/histogram_profile_383.rs in each checkout. Run cargo rustc -p krabka-promql --example histogram_profile_383 --locked -- --extern allocation_counter=/tmp/383-profile-deps/liballocation_counter.rlib. Both builds use the root Cargo.lock and a shared target directory.
scope: Complete in-memory native-histogram rate query and result drop. Warmup and fixture construction excluded. Allocations counted on the current thread, separately from timing. No concurrent build during capture.
repeat_capture: capture_repeat.py reads the first complete CSV row and terminates the remaining cases, in base/fix/fix/base order. Original binaries are reused without recompilation.
